basic_details.job_title: NIFTEM-K Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Consultant, Jr Consultant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management, Kundli (NIFTEM-K), an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI), Government of India, is filling two contractual positions: one Consultant (Audit & Finance) and one Jr Consultant (Audit & Finance). Only retired Government Servants of the stated service and pay level can apply. Applications must be emailed to [email protected] by 13 December 2026, till 11.59 PM, which the notice calls the last date for submission and the last date of receipt of applications.

content_sections.heading: About NIFTEM-K
content_sections.text: NIFTEM-K is the short name the notice uses for the National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management, Kundli. The notice describes it as an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI), Government of India. Both positions are purely on a contractual basis at NIFTEM-Kundli.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice asks for applications to be submitted at the email address [email protected] . The notice does not print a subject line or a postal address for applications. Download the application form from the website www.niftem.ac.in . Complete the form with the photograph, signatures and other documents. An incomplete form without these will be summarily rejected. Email the application to [email protected] on or before 13.12.2026, 11.59 PM. In case of difficulty in submitting the application, the notice gives the number 0130-228-1020. NIFTEM-K will not entertain any correspondence about incomplete information and evidences, or about consideration of late applications.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility: Retired Government Servant from Central/ State Government/ Autonomous Bodies/ Statutory Bodies/ PSU/ Research Organization/University Services in GP ₹6,600/- (Level-11) or above from Finance Division of Central Government, or Account Officers in GP ₹5,400/- (Level-10) and above from Accounts cadre of Central/State Government/Autonomous Bodies. Age limit: Below 65 years. Duration: 12 months (Contractual; to be extended on performance review). Eligibility: Retired Government Servant from Central/ State Government/ Autonomous Bodies/ Statutory Bodies/ PSU/ Research Organization/ University Services in GP ₹4,800/- (Level-8) or above from Finance Division of Central Government, or Assistant Account Officers from Accounts cadre of Central/State Government/Autonomous Bodies. Age limit: Below 65 years. Duration: 12 months (Contractual; to be extended on performance review). The date for determining educational qualifications, experience and the upper age limit is the last date of receipt of applications. The notice does not specify the minimum educational qualification or experience in years. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility details of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIFTEM-K Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 positions: one Consultant (Audit & Finance) and one Jr Consultant (Audit & Finance), both on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIFTEM-K Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 13.12.2026, till 11.59 PM, at [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the Consultant (Audit & Finance) post?
faq.answer: A retired Government Servant from Central/State Government/Autonomous Bodies/Statutory Bodies/PSU/Research Organization/University Services in GP ₹6,600/- (Level-11) or above from Finance Division of Central Government, or Account Officers in GP ₹5,400/- (Level-10) and above from Accounts cadre of Central/State Government/Autonomous Bodies.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible for the Jr Consultant (Audit & Finance) post?
faq.answer: A retired Government Servant from the same listed services in GP ₹4,800/- (Level-8) or above from Finance Division of Central Government, or Assistant Account Officers from Accounts cadre of Central/State Government/Autonomous Bodies.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit for both posts is below 65 years, counted on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Consultant and Jr Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Each post pays the Basic Pay at the time of retirement minus Basic Pension plus Transport Allowance, or a fixed amount, whichever is higher. The fixed amount is ₹80,000 per month for Consultant and ₹60,000 per month for Jr Consultant.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NIFTEM-K Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the application form from www.niftem.ac.in and email it with the photograph, signatures and other documents to [email protected] by 13.12.2026, 11.59 PM. For difficulty, the notice gives 0130-228-1020.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on merit, qualification and relevant experience and then called for the interview by SMS alert or email. Candidates must bring original certificates and other relevant documents to the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the job permanent, and for how long is the contract?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely contractual. The duration is 12 months, to be extended on performance review.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
